description: Stream text into a field one keystroke at a time, at a human pace — a real key event per character, pauses that vary, and longer breaths after punctuation. Use page.fillInput when you just need the value in the field; use this when the page should watch someone type.

charDelayMs.description: Average milliseconds between keystrokes; overrides "speed" when given

clear.description: Replace existing content instead of appending

jitter.description: How much each pause varies at random, as a fraction of it — 0 types in an even machine rhythm, 1 is wildly uneven

pressEnter.description: Press Enter afterwards, which submits many forms

speed.description: Typing pace: "slow" ≈ 30 wpm, "natural" ≈ 55 wpm, "fast" ≈ 110 wpm, "instant" fires every keystroke back to back with no pause

target.description: Element to type into; defaults to the currently focused element

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain
Text to type, character by character
